scope: Passive cross-capture request detection; no attack execution or traffic replay
training: All normal training requests and all source-capture requests; chronological within each stream; global training-only positive class weighting; fixed final epoch; no test selection
calibration: Normal-only calibration requests; quantile higher at 0.99; strict score > threshold
state: Reset between epochs, distinct captures and normal partitions; graph and TGN see previous minibatches only, batch-size=128; sequence windows never cross stream boundaries
labels: Training uses original request-row normal/non-normal labels including portscan intervals; semantic-only and producer-candidate subsets reported separately
secrets: No bodies, response codes, tokens, UUIDs, subscriber IDs, frame numbers, absolute epochs or labels used as input features
inference: Current request metadata and method/resource are observable; graph history and memory updated only after scoring the whole minibatch
ci_success: Successful execution and invariants; no requirement that a complex model wins
limitations: Only two attack captures; initialization seeds are not independent traffic replications
Labels can include interleaved ordinary procedures
No authenticated caller roles or authorization outcome
Mini-batch TGN uses a last-message aggregator, persistent GRU memory and temporal-neighbor attention; not bit-for-bit reproduction of upstream hyperparameters
